_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7: the tile decompressor ($DB52-$DC74). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): switch to the block's bank
regions.description: The live bank saved; bank `$06` (the block's bank, put there by `$D7F9`) selected.

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): state
regions.description: `$0B`: bit 0 = running; `LSR`: running goes on at `$DB65`; the next bit (value 2 = just armed) loads the header (`$DC5A`); 0 = idle, return. **Other bits while running: bit 7 = a run section (`[value][count]` pairs), bit 6 = mirror mode (bits reversed), bit 5 = a run being emitted.**

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): this call's budget
regions.description: The room in the PPU queue: `$4D` - `$21`, or `$2D` - `$21` while a staged row is pending (`$A5`). **No room returns.** It is called every game-loop pass (`$FF9B`) and from the drain loop (`$D7C3`).

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): reserve the item
regions.description: Budget bytes (+ 3 for the header) reserved (`$D6E0`); `$12` = `$13` = the budget; Y := 0.

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): resume a run
regions.description: Bit 5 set (a run was interrupted by the budget) jumps to its emission (`$DC08`).

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): the next source byte
TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): the escape: switch mode
regions.description: Bit 7 toggled (literal <-> run section). **If the next byte is also the escape (two in a row) the block is over:** `$0B` := 0 and the item is flushed with the bytes made so far.

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): the mirror escape
regions.description: The byte equals `$0A`: bit 6 toggled; **on, the two bytes after it are a pointer and decoding continues there (Y := 0, `$0D:$0C` := the pointer); off, the pointer after it is skipped.**

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): mirror mode: reverse the bits
regions.description: In mirror mode the byte is bit-reversed (eight `ASL A / ROR $10`).

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): a literal byte
regions.description: Outside a run section the byte goes into the queue item (`$0103,X`) and the budget `$12` counts down (done at 0); inside a run section it is the value of a pair.

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): a run section pair
regions.description: The value into `$07`, bit 5 toggled (emitting) and the next byte is the count `$08` (**0 means 256**).

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): emit the run
regions.description: The value is written count times, interrupted when the budget `$12` is used up (the rest is kept in `$08`, bit 5 stays set); at the end bit 5 is cleared.

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): full item
TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): flush the item
regions.description: The queue item `[count][destination hi][destination lo]` completed and committed (`$D6F7`); **the destination `$0F:$0E` += count, the source `$0D:$0C` += Y.**

regions.name: TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): restore the bank
TILE DECOMPRESSOR (bank 7 `$DB52`, slot `$C156`; state `$0B`, source `$0D:$0C`, destination `$0F:$0E`, bank `$06`, escapes `$09` / `$0A`): the header
regions.description: The two bytes at the source: the escape `$09` and the mirror escape `$0A`; `$0B` := 1 (running); the source advanced past them. **RUN: 106 blocks of banks 1-3 (every id with a block, through `$D7F9` and the drain) decoded to exactly what the independent Python codec `tgl/gfx.py` produces, in at most 34 frames; the table bases `$8010`, `$8024`, `$8020` are thereby confirmed as the routine uses them.**
